collision_boundary.C195: C195 is scalar periodic viscous Burgers dynamics; C300 is a two-field inviscid Riemann solver with two genuinely nonlinear families and four wave patterns.
collision_boundary.pressureless_warning: vacuum and delta-shock behavior at a=0 are excluded singular limits, not imported conclusions.

boundary_rows.statement: a>0 and both input densities positive with finite velocities.
the monotone root is positive for every datum in the theorem chamber.
equality with either reference density deletes exactly that wave.
two zero waves occur exactly for identical left and right states.
common positive density scaling preserves velocities, ratios, types, and speeds.
zero-density input traces need a separate boundary theory.
fixed separating data can drive the intermediate density exponentially to zero as a decreases.
fixed compressive data can drive the intermediate density to infinity and toward concentration as a decreases.

model.normalization: physical density and velocity; no arithmetic normalization
model.parameters: a>0, rho_L>0, rho_R>0, u_L and u_R finite real

nonclaims: No target arithmetic local datum, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, divisor law, functional equation, or zero match is asserted.
Densities, characteristic speeds, and wave families are source PDE data, not rational-prime labels or prime-power weights.
The entropy solution semigroup is not asserted to be a Hilbert-Polya operator.
No literature priority is claimed for the classical Lax Riemann construction or isothermal wave curves.

proof_contract.entropy_formula: shock production equals a^3 rho_0 sqrt(r)[log r-(r-r^{-1})/2], strictly negative for r>1
proof_contract.finite_role: finite cases regress formulas and signs; the full-data theorem is analytic
proof_contract.monotonicity: each wave function is C1 strictly increasing from minus infinity to plus infinity
proof_contract.wave_signs: family 1 uses the negative Hugoniot sign and family 2 the positive sign

references.role: classical Lax hyperbolic-system and Riemann construction owner

theorem_contract.entropy: each shock has strict negative mechanical entropy production and each fan is an entropy equality
theorem_contract.patterns: the two density comparisons give all four nondegenerate shock/rarefaction patterns and all zero-wave boundaries
theorem_contract.pressureless: a down to zero is a singular excluded boundary, not a theorem corollary
theorem_contract.root: one strictly increasing scalar equation has exactly one rho_star>0 for every declared datum
theorem_contract.vacuum: finite velocities and positive input densities at a>0 never create an isothermal vacuum
